newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish paedophile pleads guilty to child murder.
newsitem.headline: Polish paedophile pleads guilty to child murder.

text.p: A Polish paedophile pleaded guilty on Thursday to sexually abusing and strangling to death a nine-year-old girl last year.
The 31-year-old man, identified only as Krzysztof P., went on trial in the southwest city of Opole.
Opole's provincial court judge said the man dragged his young neighbour to his flat as she was leaving for school,and sexually abused and strangled her,.
"The man first wanted to let the girl go but he got scared that she might tell what happened. So he strangled her with his bare hands...and then cut her body into pieces," the judge told Reuters.
The murder occurred on October 3 last year in the town of Byczyna, near Opole.
Police were alerted when Krzysztof's neighbours said he had been seen carrying suspicious-looking plastic bags out of his house.
"It turned out that he was disposing of body parts in the bags," Krzwczyk said.
The man faces a sentence of at least eight years in prison or even the death penalty, although capital punishment is currently suspended in Poland under a parliamentary resolution.
The court ruling was expected this month, the judge said.
